Name: Pet Portraits for Content Patcher
Author: indecisiv
Description:
Adds new portraits into the game for each pet skin, horse, and a secret portrait. They can be found in the traveling merchant's shop when unlock conditions have been met! 

Easily configurable if you just want to access the portraits without a challenge. If "AvailableFromStart" is set to true you can buy 1 of each portrait at Marnie's supply shop. I suggest getting generic mod config to change this, but can be changed by editing the config.json

How to unlock each portrait if "AvailableFromStart" is set to false:
Dog/Cat/Turtle portrait:
[spoiler]Have 5 hearts with your first pet[/spoiler]

Horse portrait:
[spoiler]Have built a stable[/spoiler]

Secret portrait:
[spoiler]
Raccoon family portrait
Have the achievement "Good Neighbors"[/spoiler]


Leave me a nice comment for any suggestions or bugs! <3
